explication: La police est construite à partir d'Iosevka : private-build-plans.toml et toolchain.lock.json pilotent tools/build.py. source: Claude, d'après l'arbre du dépôt et le README
explication_en: The font is built from Iosevka: private-build-plans.toml and toolchain.lock.json drive tools/build.py. The generated fonts are validated (validate_fonts.py, font_evidence.py), promoted to release by promote_rc.py according to release-contract.json, then presented on the site site/index.html.
